summary: Brett Beasley, 47, of Salida and a 14-year-old boy cross-country skiing near Uncle Bud's 10th Mountain Division cabin near Leadville had not been heard from since 10:30 a.m. Wednesday; found Thursday at 2:30 p.m. in Porcupine Gulch; Beasley died while being treated for hypothermia, the boy was uninjured
location: Porcupine Gulch, near Uncle Bud's cabin
responding_agency: Lake County Sheriff's Office; Summit County Rescue Group
notes: UN story opened run 448; incident-start date per convention (last heard from Wed 2017-01-04, found Thu 2017-01-05); CAIC had issued an avalanche warning for the search area Thursday. Zero Beasley/Uncle Bud rows + zero Lake rows 2017-01-01--10.
